title: The canvas says which version of a component you are looking at
goal: When a component holds a normal and a disabled look, the two drawings sit side by side on the canvas wearing the same name, so there is no way to tell from the picture which one is which. The label above each drawing should say the version, and the copies should be readable at a glance too.
notes: The canvas mark is drawn in ComponentPanel.swift ComponentGlyph and placed by the canvas overlay that prints the component name above a main. Layer.componentVersionName is the string; PhotonzDocument.versionName(of:counts:) is the same only-while-there-are-several rule the layers row uses.
acceptance: The label above an original names the version when its component holds more than one, and stays as it is when it holds one
A copy on the canvas can be told from a copy showing another version without opening a panel
Nothing changes for a component with a single version

log.note: Adversarial review before building: the mock idea 'label every copy too' would put twelve chips reading Default on a screen made of twelve ordinary buttons. Cut it down to the odd one out: an original always names its version once its component holds more than one (same rule the layers row uses), a COPY only speaks when it is showing something other than the first version. Shortest thing that delivers the value.
Core: PhotonzDocument.canvasVersionNames() in ComponentVersions.swift, one walk, empty for every document without versions. Five tests in ComponentVersionTests.
App: CanvasNameChip carries a version; CanvasComponents draws the name then the version after a middle dot, dimmer on an original, full violet on a copy.

Live playtest found the first cut broken: on an 81% zoom button the strip was 54pt wide and the version ate the whole name, so the label read '. Default' with no Button in it. Fixed in core with CanvasNameLabel.fitsWholeText: a label carrying a version widens its box to fit, still capped at 240. Three tests in CanvasNameLabelTests.

Verified live on Photonz Probe with Screen Recording granted (Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/component-versions-walk.json): originals read 'Button . Default' and 'Button . Disabled', the plain copy wears its bare diamond, the Disabled copy says Disabled, and deleting the second original puts every label back to plain Button. Audit 2026-09-06-canvas-version-labels.json with two -sc.png captures.
Scripts/test.sh green: 3771 tests. Next only (all of it behind next-components), Current untouched.

An original on the canvas now prints which version it is after its name once its component holds more than one, and a copy showing something other than the first version says so above itself. Core rule in PhotonzDocument.canvasVersionNames plus CanvasNameLabel.fitsWholeText so the version never eats the name on a small box; drawn in CanvasComponents. Scripts/test.sh green (3771), verified live on the probe with the component-versions playtest walk and Screen Recording granted. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-06-canvas-version-labels.json
